execution_logic: Step 1: Search project files for App_Schema_v4.json and known tracker files under /mnt/data and project repositories.
Step 2: If tracker found: extract company name from recipient.profile_url, recipient.company, or LinkedIn profile snapshot.
Step 3: Run fuzzy match against tracker Company field (fuzzy threshold=0.85).
Step 4: Return array of matching application records with fields: company, role, last_contact_date, status, tracker_id, matched_score.
Error handling: retry up to 2 times on transient I/O errors with exponential backoff; on permanent failure return empty array and annotate runtime_context.prescan_error

bullet_punctuation.validation: All bullets must end with period '.' character
bullet_punctuation.on_fail: Auto-correct: append '.' to bullets missing periods

natural_hyphen_preservation.validation: Scan for unnatural hyphens removed AND natural hyphens preserved

competency_word_count_balance.validation: All 6 competencies must have word counts within 22-28 words. Coefficient of variation < 0.25
competency_word_count_balance.check_method: Calculate word count per competency, compute variance, flag if CV > 0.25
competency_word_count_balance.on_fail: Regenerate with constraint: 'Balance all competencies to 25±3 words'

calculation.avg_words_per_bullet: (sum of K.6 bullets + sum of K.7 bullets) / 13

on_out_of_range.ratio_below_1.0: Recommendation: Expand competencies with more detail
on_out_of_range.ratio_above_2.0: Recommendation: Condense competencies OR expand bullets

competency_bullet_ratio.display: Show calculation and recommendation in QA summary

cross_section_redundancy.validation: Check for phrases appearing in 2+ sections (K.5, K.6, K.7, K.9, K.8). Target: <10% overlap
cross_section_redundancy.check_method: Tokenize all sections, compute n-gram overlap (n=3,4,5), flag duplicates
cross_section_redundancy.on_fail: Display redundancy report, rephrase duplicates following priority: Bullets > Competencies > Executive Summary

simplified_mode.description: No ASCII visualization when detailed reasoning declined
output_components: K-node Headers with section numbers (4K2, 5K4 format)
QA Validation Tables (verification checks without intermediate steps)
simplified_mode.note: App Schema v4 JSON blocks STILL generated even in simplified mode for downstream integration
